title: AlloyDB Autoscaling: Scale by Connection Count
summary: AlloyDB v1alpha now supports autoscaling based on connection count. Configure a `connectionsCount` policy within your autoscaling `Policy` to automatically adjust instance capacity based on active connections.
details: Developers can now leverage a new `connectionsCount` property within the `Policy` schema to define autoscaling behavior. This property references the newly introduced `ConnectionsCount` schema, which includes an optional `targetCount` field. This `targetCount` allows you to specify the desired number of connections for the autoscaler to maintain, enabling more efficient resource utilization and better handling of fluctuating workloads.
